Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 451 AM EST Mon Nov 2 2026

- Mostly cloudy and mild today and Tuesday. Near record 
high temperatures Tuesday.  

- Mild conditions continue Wednesday with increasing potential for 
light rain.

&&

.AVIATION...

Southerly warm advection develops this morning as low pressure lifts 
into northern Minnesota. Increasing moisture within this flow 
results current mid-cloud steadily lowering late morning-afternoon 
towards low VFR and eventually MVFR ceilings by evening. Current of 
low level moisture is directed into central Michigan late this 
evening with the northern TAF sites residing along its periphery. As 
such, a period of IFR remains possible so maintained inherited 
Tempos. Some pockets of drizzle/light rain are possible mainly late 
evening/tonight however coverage and intensities currently don't 
warrant mention in TAFs. Developing warm sector expands over SE MI 
by Tuesday AM supporting breezier conditions but increased mixing 
which should allow for a return toward VFR skies. 

For DTW...Ceilings will drop below 5000 feet early afternoon as 
elevated portions of a warm front lift into SE Michigan. Ceilings 
will then continue to lower to MVFR by evening. Lower potential to 
reach IFR given drier resident air and main moisture directed 
further north. Drizzle/light rain will also be plausible, but is not 
expected to cause any restrictions. Ceiling improvements expected by 
Tuesday morning.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High in ceilings aob 5000 ft early afternoon and evening.
